layout.header: magic 'FRM1' u32 | records u32 | origin_x_m i32 | origin_y_m i32 | year u16 | version u16 (3) | 12 bytes zero

columns.x: i32 metres east of the km plane's origin
columns.a: u16 with a statement that year
columns.f: u16 with a usable baseline and a revenue value
columns.rv: u16 log code of the summed revenue (line 2110, thousands of rubles) of every firm with a statement and a positive value at the address, listed firms included: 10^((rv - 1) / 100); 0 without revenue
columns.cls: u8 relative revenue-change class of the address's filers (0 none, 1 to 6)
columns.mix: eight (ind u8, ish u8) pairs: the divisions with revenue at the address by share descending, ish the rounded percent of the address's revenue; 255 and 0 beyond the present divisions; ind1 and ish1 are the leader (255 and 0 where no firm has a revenue value; 0 a firm without a division code)

layout.byte_order: little-endian, struct of arrays in the column order x, y, n, a, f, rv, cls, ind1, ish1, ..., ind8, ish8, gzip -9

metric: the firm's own percent change against its 2019-2021 average, minus the median change of the drawn firms on no list in the same year

industry.encoding: ind (u8): 1 to 99 the two-digit division, 0 no OKVED 2 division code (class Other), 255 no firm with a statement and a positive revenue value (unknown, neutral); shares are integer percent of nominal revenue (line 2110) within the year
industry.division_titles_source: Eurostat, NACE Rev. 2 codelist NACE_R2 version 20.1 (dissemination API, retrieved 2026-10-25); OKVED 2 (OK 029-2014) uses the same two-digit codes
industry.equivalence: OKVED 2 (OK 029-2014, Rosstat order of 31 January 2014) is built on NACE Rev. 2 with identical codes through four digits and national extensions at five and six digits; at the two-digit level the 88 division codes coincide (checked against the programming project's OKVED 2 crosswalk, motion.classifier-crosswalk, from Rosstat's OKVED2 download recorded in motion.classifier-sources); titles are translations and differ in emphasis (division 84's Russian title names military security and compulsory social insurance); known departures lie below the two-digit level and do not affect this layer. Codes outside OKVED 2 seen in the registry (__MISSING__, 00, 34, 40, 57) carry pseudo-division 0.

rules.address: one record per distinct registered address at 1 m rounding of firms on no supplied list with below-city-level geocodes; city-level geocodes and listed firms are counted in by_year and not in the files (listed firms: treatednational.json)
rules.marks: below 20 px per km: 1 px marks, 2x2 blocks for 10 or more firms, 3x3 for 100 or more, alpha by count; from 20 px per km: discs of radius min(cap, base + s * sqrt(n - 1)) / 2 with (base, s, cap) = (2, 0.6, 8) below 60 px per km and (3, 1.1, 11) above (the thresholds the atlas draws with, aligned with the Moscow extents, 24 October 2026)
rules.colours: share layer: the address's statement share in the six-class ramp with the 100 km breaks; revenue layer: cls in the blue ramp, 0 neutral; other layers neutral

notes: Registered addresses, not operating sites; firms at one address are one record.
No firm is named or identified; the files carry counts and classes only.
